status: REGISTERED by the lead on main (11 November 2026) before any model computed an Em for J1. The first Em under these defaults, from R-full, is the prediction of record.
marks: V read in the full text; S our arithmetic or interpretation; F read off a figure; T standard table

time.note: J1 is read at onset of second cleavage, 30 min (dLB74 p13 and single-egg traces 29.5-30.6 min, F). The trace spread is smaller than the onset range below, which changes the insertion duration the same way, so the J1 time itself is not ranged.

observable.quantity: Em, cytosol minus bath, of normal eggs (vitelline membrane intact, no cytochalasin B) at onset of second cleavage
observable.prediction_of_record: Em at j1_s from the reference (R-full) under every default, with the access factor A/L calibrated on rm2_target_ohm, whatever it is (computed_after_registration)

rm_definition.basis: dLB74 p530 (V): constant-current pulses of 1.2 s and 3e-8 A every 10 s, polarity alternated; intracellular voltages sampled every second in phase with the front edges of the pulses. Rm is the simulated response to this protocol, in the reference and in the engine, not a linear-circuit value.
rm_definition.sign_convention: positive current enters the cytosol and leaves through the membranes (depolarizing)
rm_definition.injected_carrier_note: Positive current is carried by K+ entering the cytosol and Cl- leaving it, in the free-solution proportion D_K/(D_K+D_Cl) of the 3 M KCl electrode filling (dLB74 p530). About 0.37 pmol per pulse, net zero over a pair.
rm_definition.em_sample: V(t_k): the potential at the front edge of pulse k (continuous there, so the pre-pulse value), with the protocol running
rm_definition.deflection: dV_k = V(t_k + 1.0 s) - V(t_k): the sample one second after the front edge, inside the 1.2-s pulse
rm_definition.rm_rule: Rm(k) = (|dV_(k-1)| + |dV_k|) / (2 x 3e-8 A): the mean of one depolarizing and one hyperpolarizing chord

rm1_target_ohm.sets: the old membrane's P_Na = P_K, from the pulse response of the uncleaved egg (pair rm1_pulse_pair); computed_after_registration and recalibrated for every band member
rm1_target_ohm.source: dLB74 Table I (p532), onset of first cleavage, normal eggs
rm1_target_ohm.note: The stage-2 smoke test set P from the slope at rest instead; that is not the same quantity at 15-25 mV excursions.

rm2_target_ohm.sets: the access factor A/L, from the pulse response at J1 (pair j1_pulse_pair); computed_after_registration and recalibrated for every band member and arm
rm2_target_ohm.source: dLB74 Table I (p532), onset of second cleavage, normal eggs, the same series as J1

cytosol_volume_m3.source: dL74 Table 2: water 0.782 +/- 0.028 (SEM) uL per egg at onset of first cleavage
cytosol_volume_m3.note: Fixed: concentrations are per litre of cell water; the volume enters only through the slow composition drift of a cytosol with no pump.

cytosol_Na_mM.source: dL74 Table 4, activity at onset of first cleavage (ion-selective electrode)
cytosol_Na_mM.note: Initial value; the cytosol then evolves. dL74's 22.4 +/- 1.1 mM at onset of second cleavage is a reported check, not an input.

cytosol_K_mM.source: dL74 Table 4, activity, first and second cleavage pooled

cytosol_Cl_mM.note: Fixed: neither membrane is Cl-permeable, so cytosolic Cl enters only the injected-current carrier.

bath.source: Steinberg's solution as in the smoke driver; a_K 0.545 mM for 0.67 mM KCl (dL74 p11) applied to every ion
bath.mark: V (a_K), S (applied to Na and Cl)
bath.note: Ca(NO3)2, MgSO4 and Tris are omitted, as in the smoke test. The lumen draws this fluid as it grows.

old_membrane.permeability_rule: P_Na = P_K = P_old with P_old set so that the pulse-protocol Rm of the uncleaved egg equals rm1_target_ohm (computed_after_registration)
old_membrane.initial_state: the cell starts at the old membrane's zero-current potential (independent of P_old when P_Na = P_K)
old_membrane.source: folded area 1.7 x 5.11 mm2 (dLB74 p534, BdL73 p93); P_Na/P_K about 1 and no Cl effect (dL74 p9); capacitance 0.62 uF/cm2 on the geometric 5.11 mm2 (DFS74 Table I), as in the smoke test
old_membrane.note: Constant through first cleavage (the parallel-branch analysis of dLB74 assumes the same). No pump (dL74 p13; K83 p1760).

new_membrane_specific_resistance_ohm_m2.range_basis: the two exposed arms (1.36 and 1.82 kOhm cm2) around the authors' mean 1.59
new_membrane_specific_resistance_ohm_m2.conversion_rule: P_K,new is set so that the constant-field slope conductance per area at -60 mV, with the declared cytosol inside and the bath outside, equals 1/r_new; P_Na,new = rho x P_K,new; P_Cl,new = 0. -60 mV is the exposed arms' Em at onset of second cleavage (-60.0 and -60.9 mV), where r_new was measured; their pulse excursions (5-10 mV) make the mean chord close to that slope.

new_membrane_PNa_over_PK.range_basis: the two exposed arms; default their mean
new_membrane_PNa_over_PK.source: dLB74 Table I means and p535 (R_new 553 and 210 kOhm): branch EMFs -90.8 mV (-VM) and -74.4 mV (+VM +CCB), each inverted through the constant-field voltage equation with the declared cytosol and bath

new_membrane_PCl.source: dLB74: 'most probably a relatively high permeability for K+'; K83: outward furrow current carried mainly by K+, reversed by Ba2+

new_membrane_specific_capacitance_F_m2.source: DFS74 Table I whole-blastomere 0.62 uF/cm2 on smooth area; design note 4.2
new_membrane_specific_capacitance_F_m2.mark: V (DFS74 value), S (use for new membrane)

inputs.new_membrane_faces: all new membrane faces the cleft lumen; none faces the bath directly. dLB74's 0.14 mm2 'effectively exposed' is a parallel-branch reading of the same Rm and is not an input.

insertion_onset_s.range_basis: stated range: the Em and Rm change invariably starts 6-8 min after onset of first cleavage
insertion_onset_s.source: dLB74 p531 and p535; new membrane present at 7-8 min, absent at 3-4 min (BdL73)

new_membrane_area_at_j1_m2.source: BdL73 Table II (p96), series 1 (normal); both faces of the cleft; measured in other eggs in 1/10 Steinberg after fixation

insertion_activation_area_m2.note: Numerical: the patch and the lumen switch on with 1e-3 mm2 at insertion onset (about 1 s of insertion). The sensitivity to 1e-10 m2 is part of the reference term.

insertion_schedule.primary: the total area at J1 and the onset are primary; the rate follows from them
insertion_schedule.default: uniform: A(t) = A0 + r (t - t_on) with r = (A_J1 - A0)/(j1_s - t_on), about 0.060 mm2/min, continuing at r after J1

band_member_back_loaded.rule: 0.04 mm2/min for 10 min from onset, then the uniform rate that reaches A_J1 at J1 (about 0.076 mm2/min under the other defaults)
band_member_back_loaded.basis: The task and design give 0.04-0.06 mm2/min. 0.04 is the rate measured in the treatment arms, constant for 7-10 min in -VM eggs (dLB74 p536, V); 0.06 is the normal-egg mean implied by the total (S). A constant 0.04 would give 0.92 mm2 at J1, outside BdL73's total, so the low end enters as this schedule shape.

gap_width_m.source: BdL73 TEM micrographs (Figs. 7-8); fixation shrinkage unknown
gap_width_m.lumen_volume_rule: V_lumen = w x A_new / 2: w times one face, since A_new counts both faces

lumen.growth: the added volume fills with bath fluid at bath composition (reservoir supply)

access.geometry: one face from the lumen to the held bath with a single geometric factor A/L, constant from activation (computed_after_registration)
access.diffusivity_source: free-solution values at 25 C as tabulated by aqion.de from phreeqc.dat (read 11 November 2026), which also cites Vanysek, CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics; consistent with limiting conductivities 50.1, 73.5, 76.4 S cm2/mol (Laidler & Meiser 1982). Only the ratios matter once A/L is calibrated, so the common temperature factor cancels.
access.selectivity_default: free_solution: k_s = (A/L) D_s with the ratios above (Nernst-Einstein)

law_definitions.constant_field: J_s (lumen to bath) = k_s z_s u (c_lumen - c_bath exp(-z_s u)) / (1 - exp(-z_s u)), u = F (phi_lumen - phi_bath) / RT
law_definitions.logmean: J_s = k_s Lm(c_lumen, c_bath) (ln(c_lumen/c_bath) + z_s u), Lm(a, b) = (a - b)/(ln a - ln b); the engine's face law logmean_electrodiffusion@1 (docs/SPATIAL_EXTRACELLULAR_SPEC.md)

access.lead_decision: law_default is 'logmean' (lead, at registration): the rim access is aqueous and electroneutral, and R-full and the engine's faces then share one law; constant_field is a reported arm

arms.change: the access law constant_field (the default is logmean)

arms.basis: design note 7: a rim seal about 30 times tighter than the open slab need not keep free-solution ratios
design note 4.2: fixation shrinkage unknown; the in-vivo gap may be narrower

band.members: each in_band input at its low and its high end, one at a time, the others at default; the schedule member is one-sided
band.recalibration: A/L is recalibrated on rm2 for every member; P_old on rm1 whenever rm1, temperature or the cytosol changes; P_K,new by its rule whenever r_new, rho, temperature or the cytosol changes
band.combination: worst case: lo = E0 + sum_i min(0, d_i-, d_i+), hi = E0 + sum_i max(0, d_i-, d_i+), with d_i = Em(member) - E0
band.corner_check: the 2^3 corners of the three inputs with the largest |d_i| (others at default); a corner outside [lo, hi] widens the band to include it
band.range_rule: stated ranges are used as given (w, c_new, r_new, rho, onset, temperature, schedule); measured means without one enter at +/- 1 SE (rm1, rm2, area, cytosol Na and K). The worst-case sum of four or more 1-SE shifts is at least a 2-SE quadrature combination.
band.arms: reported with their Em and verdict; they do not enter the band

judging.pass: [lo - t, hi + t] overlaps [m - 2 SE, m + 2 SE] = [-21.9, -18.7] mV
judging.t: numerical tolerance: the reference term of R-full (solver settings and activation area), plus at S4 the engine's step term; fixed by the S4 protocol
judging.derivation: The nearer and firmer failure limit is the sealed or identical-membrane value, the old membrane's zero-current potential L_s = -9.9 mV (measured -9.7 +/- 0.6 mV at onset of first cleavage). A passing band has lo - t <= m + 2 SE = -18.7 mV, so its top can reach -18.7 mV + W. Every passing band excludes L_s only if -18.7 + W < -9.9, i.e. W < 8.8 mV (9.0 with the measured -9.7); 8 mV keeps a 0.8-mV margin. The other limit, a bath-equivalent lumen (-37 to -44 mV, linear estimate), allows W < 15.1 mV and does not bind. The number follows from the limits and the datum only, not from any expected band.

reported_not_judged: Em and Rm time courses from 0 to 35 min (onset at 6-8 min, the change over 7-17 min, the late 1-3 mV depolarisation)
the separate depolarizing and hyperpolarizing chords at J1, and Em at J1 without the pulse train
lumen composition and potential; cytosolic Na at J1 against dL74's 22.4 +/- 1.1 mM

the exposed arms (-VM and +VM +CCB) simulated with the new membrane facing the bath: Em and Rm at second cleavage against dLB74 Table I (a consistency check of the r_new and rho rules, which come from the same arms)
the bath-equivalent and sealed limits under the J1 inputs
stated_limits: well-mixed cytosol; uniform, constant old membrane; held bath
no pump; no Ca2+ or Cl- currents; no gating of the new K conductance beyond constant field
cytosol and bath on the activity basis; bound ions not represented; bath Ca, Mg and buffer omitted
prescribed lumen volume with no water flow; constant A/L from activation (a rim that tightens late is not modelled)
vitelline membrane and perivitelline space not modelled; ideal electrodes

reference_numerics.integrator: scipy.integrate.solve_ivp Radau, rtol 1e-10, split at every pulse edge and sample time
reference_numerics.states: free-node charges (cytosol, lumen) and the Na and K amounts of both; Cl from charge
reference_numerics.reference_term: largest |dEm| at J1 against rtol 1e-8, BDF at rtol 1e-10, and activation area 1e-10 m2; reported with the prediction
reference_numerics.procedure: the limits and synthetic cases are tested first; the commit is frozen; the defaults are then run once, logged, and that Em is the prediction of record

lead_decisions: Access law default. The brief says constant field; the engine's faces use logmean_electrodiffusion@1. Recommended: logmean as default, because the rim access is aqueous and electroneutral (the log-mean law is exact for linear concentration profiles there, while constant field assumes a linear potential, as in a membrane), and because R-full and the S4 engine run then share one law. The other law is a reported arm either way.
Arms reported-only, not in the band: the cation-selective seal and w = 0.5 um (design note 7 and 9 read both ways).
The back-loaded schedule as an in-band member (from the 0.04-0.06 mm2/min range).
Maximum band width 8 mV including 2 t.
lead_decisions_taken: 1. Access law default: logmean (logmean_electrodiffusion form); constant_field is a reported arm.
2. The cation-selective seal (access D_Cl = 0) and w = 0.5 um are reported-only arms, not in the band.
3. The back-loaded insertion schedule (0.04 mm2/min for 10 min, then about 0.076) is an in-band member.
4. Maximum band width W = (hi - lo) + 2t <= 8 mV; beyond it J1 is reported, not judged. The default point prediction's distance from the measured mean is reported alongside.
